checks.text: The page heading reads "Tournament Bracket" and the tab labelled "Bracket" is active by default.
In the "Players" tab, typing "Alice" in the field labelled "Player name" and clicking "Add player" adds a row in the table with the text "Alice" and the seed number "1".
After adding players "Alice", "Bob", "Carol", and "Dave", the "Bracket" tab displays four match slots in the first round: "Alice vs Bob", "Carol vs Dave", and two empty slots for the second round.
In the "Bracket" tab, clicking the button labelled "Winner: Alice" in the first match slot highlights "Alice" and moves her name into the first slot of the second round.
After setting "Alice" as the winner of the first match and "Dave" as the winner of the second match, the second round slot displays "Alice vs Dave".
Clicking the button labelled "Winner: Alice" in the final match slot displays the text "Champion: Alice" in the results area.
In the "Results" tab, the table shows a row for the final match with columns "Match", "Winner", and "Score", displaying "Final", "Alice", and "1-0".
Clicking the button labelled "Export CSV" copies the text "Match,Winner,Score\nFinal,Alice,1-0" to the clipboard.
Reload keeps the champion: after setting "Alice" as the champion, reloading the page still displays "Champion: Alice" in the results area.
